title: RecipeBookBlocker
description: Removes or disables the recipe book button in the inventory screen to prevent accidental openings of the recipe book and to keep the inventory interface clean and minimal.
body:
RecipeBookBlocker removes or disables the Recipe Book button in the inventory screen. This prevents the Recipe Book from opening by accident while using items and keeps the inventory clean and simple.

The mod is made for players who do not use the Recipe Book and want to avoid unwanted openings caused by misclicks. It is especially useful in faster game modes where quick inventory handling is important. It also helps when using custom keybinds like TAB or other keys near the inventory controls, which can sometimes trigger the Recipe Book by mistake.
